description: Realistic file layouts for tests/detect.test.ts: each fixture is a real tool's export header with a handful of sample rows, the industry Loupe should rank first (several ids when any is acceptable, null when none fits) and whether the guided 'please confirm' flow should open. The test expands the samples to rowCount rows: 'unique' columns get a new value per row, 'ids' columns repeat from a pool, numbers and dates are drawn within the sampled range in the sampled format, and other columns are redrawn from the samples. Demo fixtures name a bundled sample generator instead.
